serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings source_type='Order' / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services) for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved columns as ledgerBookedMin.
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative booked load from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities' own reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible - never use it as the booked side. onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy. null means no service_capacities row for that site/day, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until the lot is edited in the admin UI. daily_order_capacity is the UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling. null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero.
